name: memShape
doc: **Membership by structural comparison.** `true` only when some element of the list has the same shape.
stmt: def memShape (c : GeoConstraint n) (G : GeoConstraintSet n) : Bool

name: firesBool
doc: **Every premise of the rule is present**, tested structurally.
stmt: def firesBool (r : Rule n) (G : GeoConstraintSet n) : Bool

name: memShape_sound
doc:
**The boolean membership test is sound**: a `true` means the constraint really is in the list.

This is where `GeoConstraint.beqShape_eq` is consumed, and it is why the engine cannot report something that is
not there: the comparison only says `true` when the structures genuinely agree.
stmt:
theorem memShape_sound (c : GeoConstraint n) (G : GeoConstraintSet n) (h : memShape c G = true) :
    c ∈ G
proof:
by
  unfold memShape at h
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hbeq⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp h
  rw [GeoConstraint.beqShape_eq hbeq]
  exact hd

name: firesBool_sound
doc: **A rule whose premise test succeeds really has all its premises present.**
stmt:
theorem firesBool_sound (r : Rule n) (G : GeoConstraintSet n) (h : firesBool r G = true) :
    Fires r G
proof:
by
  intro c hc
  unfold firesBool at h
  exact memShape_sound c G (List.all_eq_true.mp h c hc)

name: fireOnce
doc:
**One firing round, executably.** Appends the conclusion of every rule whose premises are present.

`List.filter` on a `Bool` needs no `Decidable` instance, which is the whole reason this definition is possible.
stmt: noncomputable def fireOnce (rules : List (Rule n)) (G : GeoConstraintSet n) : GeoConstraintSet n
proof: G ++ (rules.filter (fun r => firesBool r G)).map Rule.concl

name: fireOnce_sound
doc: **The executable round is sound.** Every constraint it produces is entailed by the input.
stmt:
theorem fireOnce_sound (rules : List (Rule n)) (G : GeoConstraintSet n) (c : GeoConstraint n)
    (h : c ∈ fireOnce rules G) : EntailsGeo G c
proof:
by
  unfold fireOnce at h
  rcases List.mem_append.mp h with hin | hin
  · exact fun pts hG => hG c hin
  · obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hin
    have hfire : Fires r G := firesBool_sound r G (List.mem_filter.mp hr).2
    exact rule_entails r G (fun d hd pts hG => hG d (hfire d hd))

name: closure
doc: **The engine, run `fuel` times.** Recursion on the budget, so `closure_sound` is an induction on it.
stmt:
noncomputable def closure (rules : List (Rule n)) : GeoConstraintSet n → ℕ → GeoConstraintSet n
  | G, 0 => G
  | G, k + 1 => closure rules (fireOnce rules G) k

name: closure_sound
doc:
**The engine never reports a constraint its input did not entail**, at any step budget.

A caller who stops early gets a weaker answer, never a wrong one -- which makes the budget a safe parameter
rather than a source of unsoundness.
stmt:
theorem closure_sound (rules : List (Rule n)) (G : GeoConstraintSet n) (fuel : ℕ)
    (c : GeoConstraint n) (h : c ∈ closure rules G fuel) : EntailsGeo G c
proof:
by
  induction fuel generalizing G with
  | zero =>
    simp only [closure] at h
    exact fun pts hG => hG c h
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [closure] at h
    have hnext : EntailsGeo (fireOnce rules G) c := ih (fireOnce rules G) h
    intro pts hG
                                                                                                       
    exact hnext pts (fun d hd => fireOnce_sound rules G d hd pts hG)

name: self_mem_closure
doc: **The engine keeps its input**, so a caller can rely on earlier constraints after any number of rounds.
stmt:
theorem self_mem_closure (rules : List (Rule n)) (G : GeoConstraintSet n) (fuel : ℕ) :
    ∀ c ∈ G, c ∈ closure rules G fuel
proof:
by
  induction fuel generalizing G with
  | zero => exact fun c hc => hc
  | succ k ih =>
    intro c hc
    exact ih (fireOnce rules G) c (List.mem_append_left _ hc)

name: const_mul_not_recognised
doc:
**A premise containing a `const` at the outermost position is not recognised**, even inside a list
containing it.

The blind spot, stated as a theorem rather than a remark. `beqShape` on `.const _` is `false` by definition, and
`GeoExpr.mul` propagates that through `Bool.and`, so the comparison fails on the first factor.
stmt:
theorem const_mul_not_recognised (c : GeoExpr n) (r : ℝ) (G : GeoConstraintSet n) :
    (GeoExpr.mul (GeoExpr.const r) c).beqShape (GeoExpr.mul (GeoExpr.const r) c) = false

name: Tolerance
doc:
**容差**：保证 `0 < tol`。

把「容差必须为正」编进类型，而不是当作一个待检查的假设。
stmt:
structure Tolerance where
             
  tol : Float
               
  pos : tol > 0

name: approxZero
doc:
**容差下的约等于零**：`|x| ≤ tol`。

用 `Float.abs` 与比较，**这是可计算的**。

name: approxZero_iff
doc:
**`approxZero` 的性质**：为真是 `Prop` 形式的断言。

**这是 `Bool` 到 `Prop` 的桥**——判定返回 `Bool`，正确性以 `Prop` 陈述。
stmt:
theorem approxZero_iff (T : Tolerance) (x : Float) :
    approxZero T x = true ↔ x.abs <= T.tol
proof:
by
  unfold approxZero
  exact Bool.decide_iff (x.abs <= T.tol)

name: approxHoldsEqZero
doc:
**`eqZero` 的可执行判定**：表达式求值后约等于零。

**这是约束层的第一条可执行检查。**
stmt:
def approxHoldsEqZero (T : Tolerance) (e : CExpr n)
    (pts : ℕ → Fin n → Float) : Bool

name: approxHoldsLeZero
doc:
**`leZero` 的可执行判定**：表达式求值后不超过容差。

`x ≤ tol` 是 `x - tol ≤ 0` 的容差版本。
stmt:
def approxHoldsLeZero (T : Tolerance) (e : CExpr n)
    (pts : ℕ → Fin n → Float) : Bool

name: approxHoldsEqZero_sound
doc:
**`eqZero` 判定的正确性**：判定为真，则该配置在容差内满足约束。

**这是 `sound` 方向**——它说「工具不会说谎」：报真时确实在容差内成立。
stmt:
theorem approxHoldsEqZero_sound (T : Tolerance) (e : CExpr n)
    (pts : ℕ → Fin n → Float) (h : approxHoldsEqZero T e pts = true) :
    (e.evalC pts).abs <= T.tol

name: approxHoldsLeZero_sound
doc: **`leZero` 判定的正确性**：判定为真，则求值不超过容差。
stmt:
theorem approxHoldsLeZero_sound (T : Tolerance) (e : CExpr n)
    (pts : ℕ → Fin n → Float) (h : approxHoldsLeZero T e pts = true) :
    e.evalC pts <= T.tol
proof:
by
  unfold approxHoldsLeZero at h
  exact of_decide_eq_true h

name: tolerance_arbitrary
doc:
**容差可任意小**：对任意正浮点数，存在一个 `Tolerance` 使用它。

**这不是「精度可任意提高」的定理**——后者受浮点表示能力限制。
它只说**用户可以选择**任意正容差。
stmt: theorem tolerance_arbitrary (t : Float) (h : t > 0) : ∃ T : Tolerance, T.tol = t
proof:
⟨⟨t, h⟩, rfl⟩
